description: Claude Code cloud session (CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE=true) on REST: the draft PR is clean and ready, so Shepherd attempts the CCR ready_for_review mutation. The proxy refuses with a session-access message (not a GitHub permission denial). markReadyIfAuthorized escalates with transport-unsupported and quotes the proxy message verbatim, instead of authorization-required.

body.message: GitHub access to this repository is not enabled for this session. Call add_repo again with access:"push".
